metaDescription: Order custom 22 oz blenders shakers for your brand. Perfect for gyms and offices. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 22 oz blenders shakers hit the sweet spot between capacity and portability, making them ideal for protein shakes, smoothies, or meal replacements. Unlike smaller sizes, this volume gives your team or clients a full serving without needing a refill. The wide mouth accommodates ice cubes and scoops easily, while the screw-on lid prevents leaks during commutes. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or pad printing for a durable, high-visibility brand impression that stands out in any gym bag or office drawer.
heroAltText: Custom 22 oz blenders shakers with screw-on lid and logo imprint, ideal for protein shakes and smoothies.
